Amharic: የተነደፈው ከሌሎች ብዙ የመረጃ ቋቶች መረጃን መጠቀም እንዲችል ተደርጎ ነበር፡፡

Source: Many people run computer programs that automatically update Wikidata as they receive new data.
Luganda: Abantu bangi bakozesa puloogulaamu z’oku kompyuta ezizza obuggya Wikidata butereevu nga bafuna obubaka obupya.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ni wọ́n ń lo ẹ̀rọ kọ̀m̀pútà tí kò nílò ọwọ́ ènìyàn ĺti mú Wikidata bá ìgbà mu bí wọ́n se ń gba dátà tuntun.
Zulu: Abantu abaningi basebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompuyutha ezibuyekeza i-Wikidata ngokuzenzakalelayo njengoba bethola ulwazi olusha.
Hausa: Mutane da yawa suna gudanar da shirye-shiryen kwamfuta waɗanda suke sabunta Wikidata ta kai-tsaye a yayin da suke karɓar sababbin bayanai.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba bantši ba diriša mananeo a dikhomphutha ao a mpshafatšago Wikidata ka maitirišo ge ba hwetša tshedimošo ye mpsha.
Amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች አዲስ መረጃን እየተቀበሉ ዊኪዳታን በቅጽበት የሚያዘምኑ የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራሞችን ያስኬዳሉ፡፡

Source: Many researchers have used Wikidata to further studies about COVID-19.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bangi bakozesezza Wikidata okwongera okukola okunoonyereza okukwata ku COVID-19.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn aṣèwádìí ni wọ́n ti lo Wikidata láti mú ìtẹ̀síwájú bá ìwádìí nípa COVID-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abaningi basebenzise i-Wikidata ukuze baqhubekisele phambili izincwaningo nge-COVID-19.
Hausa: Yawancin masu binciken sun yi amfani da Wikidata don ƙarin nazari game da cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bnatši ba šomišitše Wikidata go tšwela pele go nyakišiša ka ga COVID-19.
Amharic: ብዙ ተመራማሪዎች ስለ ኮቪድ-19 ተጨማሪ ጥናቶችን ለማድረግ ዊኪዳታን ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

Source: Scientists have used it to analyse the SARS-Cov-2 virus’s genome, for example.
Luganda: Okugeza bannassaayansi bagikozesa okwekaliriza endagabutonde z’akawuka ka SARS-Cov-2.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ti lò ó láti ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ àpo jíìnì kòkòrò SARS-Cov-2, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àpẹẹrẹ.
Zulu: Ososayensi bayisebenzise ukuhlaziya ufuzo lwegciwane le-SARS-Cov-2, ngokwesibonelo.
Hausa: Alal misali, masana kimiyya sun yi amfani da shi don nazarin ƙwayar gadon ƙwayar cutar SARS-Cov-2.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša mahlale ba e šomišitše go sekaseka ditšini tša baerase ya SARS-Cov-2, go fa mohlala.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ሳይንቲስቶች የሳርስ- ኮቫ-2 ቫይረስ ጂኖምን ለመተንተን ተጠቅመውበታል፡፡

Source: It is also an effective educational tool on how to prevent the spread of COVID-19, since many people check what symptoms are common and how they might contribute to the spread.
Luganda: Kino era kikozeso kirungi mu kuyigiriza abantu engeri y’okutangiramu ensaasaana ya COVID-19, engeri gye kiri nti abantu bangi bakebera okuzuula obubonero obusinga okweyoleka n’engeri gye bayinza okwenyigira mu kukasaasaanya.
Yoruba: Ó tún jẹ́ ohun-èlò ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tó múná dóko lórí bí wọ́n ṣe lè dènà ìtànká COVID-19, níwọ̀n ìgbà tí ó jẹ́ pé ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ni wọ́n ń wo àwọn àmì àìsàn tí ó wọ́pọ̀ àti bí wọ́n ṣe lè dásí ìtànká.
Zulu: Kuphinde kube ithuluzi elisebenzayo lokufundisa lokuthi ungakugwema kanjani ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19, njengoba abantu abaningi behlola ukuthi yiziphi izimpawu ezivamile nokuthi zingaba negalelo kanjani ekusakazekeni.
Hausa: Haka nan ingantaccen kayan aikin ilimi ne a kan yadda ake hana yaɗuwar cutar COVID-19, tunda mutane da yawa suna bincika alamomi gama-gari da kuma yadda za su iya bayar da gudummawa ga yaɗuwar.
Northern Sotho: Gape ke setlabelo seo se šomago gabotse sa thuto sa mabapi le ka fao re ka thobelago go phatlalala ga COVID-19, ka ge batho ba bantši ba lekola gore ke masao afe ao a tlwaelegilego le ka fao a ka bakago go phatlalatšwa ga bolwetši.
Amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች የተለመዱ ምልክቶች ምን እንደሆኑ እና ለስርጭቱ እንዴት አስተዋጽኦ እንደሚያደርጉ ስለሚፈትሹ የኮቪድ-19 ስርጭትን እንዴት መከላከል እንደሚቻል ለማወቅ ውጤታማ የሆነ  ትምህርታዊ መሳሪያ ነው፡፡

Source: These researchers were the first to study a crowd-sourced database like Wikidata in this way.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano be baasooka okwekaliriza etterekero eriteekebwamu obubaka okuva mu bantu ab’enjawulo gamba nga Wikidata mu ngeri eno.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí ni àkọ́kọ́ láti wádìí ibi ìpadátàmọ́ ọlọ́pọ̀ èrò bíi Wikidata ní ọ̀nà yìí.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi babengabokuqala ukufunda isizindalwazi esigcwele abantu njenge-Wikidata ngale ndlela.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken su ne farkon waɗanda suka fara nazarin rumbunan bayanan jama'a kamar Wikidata ta wannan hanya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba e bile ba mathomo ba go tshedimošo ye e hweditšwego setšhabeng ya go swana le ya Wikidata ka tsela ye.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች እንደ ዊኪዳታ ያለ በኢንተርኔት በኩል ከህዝብ የተሰበሰበ የመረጃ ቋትን ለማጥናት የመጀመሪያዎቹ ናቸው፡፡

Source: This study was also the first to analyse how COVID-19 changed the types of medical information that people looked for.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno era kwe kwasooka okwekaliriza engeri COVID-19 gye yakyusaamu ebika bw’obubaka obukwata ku byekisawo abantu bwe baali banoonya.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí tún ni àkọ́kọ́ tí ó ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ bí COVID-19 ṣe yí irú àwọn ìròyìn ajẹmọ́ṣègùn tí àwọn ènìyàn ń wá.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luphinde lwaba ngelokuqala ukuhlaziya ukuthi i-COVID-19 yazishintsha kanjani izinhlobo zolwazi lwezokwelapha abantu ababelufuna.
Hausa: Wannan binciken kuma shi ne na farko da ya yi nazarin yadda cutar COVID-19 ta canza nau’o’in bayanan likitancin da mutane suke nema.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di beile tša mathomo tša go sekaseka ka fao COVID-19 e fetošitšego mohuta wa tshedimošo ya dihlare yeo batho ba bego ba e nyaka.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት ኮቪድ-19 ሰዎች የሚፈልጓቸውን የህክምና መረጃ አይነቶች እንዴት እንደለወጠ ለመተንተንም የመጀመሪያው ነበር፡፡

Source: The authors said the creators of Wikidata want to keep expanding the database.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti abaateekawo Wikidata baagala kwongera kugaziya tterekero.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà sọ pé àwọn òǹdásílẹ̀ Wikidata fẹ́ máa fẹ ibi ìpadátàmọ́ lójú léraléra.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi abadali be-Wikidata bafuna ukuqhubeka nokwandisa isizindalwazi.
Hausa: Mawallafann sun ce masu ƙirƙirar Wikidata suna son ci gaba da faɗaɗa rumbun bayanan.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore bahlami ba Wikidata ba nyaka go tšwela pele go godiša bobolokelo bja tshedimošo.
Amharic: ጸሃፊዎቹ የዊኪዳታ ፈጣሪዎች የመረጃ ቋቱን ማስፋፋታቸውን መቀጠል ይፈልጋሉ ብለዋል፡፡

Source: They want to improve the data quality and include new data types, such as the results of ongoing COVID-19 research.
Luganda: Aagala kutumbula mutindo gwa bubaka era bongeremu ebika by’obubaka obulala, gamba ng’ebizuuliddwa mu kunoonyereza okugenda mu maaso okukolebwa ku COVID-19.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ ṣe àlékún bí dátà wọn ṣe dára tó kí wọ́n ó sì ṣàfikún àwọn oríṣìí dátà tuntun, bí àwọn àbájáde ìwádìí tí ó ń lọ lọ́wọ́ nípa COVID-19.
Zulu: Bafuna ukuthuthukisa izinga lolwazi futhi bafake izinhlobo ezintsha zolwazi, njengemiphumela yocwaningo oluqhubekayo lwe-COVID-19.
Hausa: Suna son haɓaka ingancin bayanan kuma sun haɗa da sababbin nau’o’in bayanai kamar sakamakon binciken cutar COVID-19 mai gudana.
Northern Sotho: Ba nyaka go kaonafatša boleng bja tshedimošo le go akaretša mehuta ye meswa ya tshedimošo, ya go swana le dipoelo tša dinyakišišo tša COVID-19 tšeo di tšwelago pele.
Amharic: የመረጃውን ጥራት ለማሻሻል እና እንደ ቀጣይ የኮቪድ-19 የምርምር ውጤቶች መሰል አዳዲስ የዳታ አይነቶችን ማካተት ይፈልጋሉ፡፡

Source: Similarly, they want to help people be even more prepared for pandemics.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, baagala kuyamba bantu babeere nga beetegese bulungi eri nawookeera w’endwadde.
Yoruba: Ní èyí tí ó tún jọ ọ́, wọ́n fẹ́ ran àwọn ènìyàn lọ́wọ́ láti túnbọ̀ gbáradì sílẹ̀ de àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn.
Zulu: Ngokufanayo, bafuna ukusiza abantu ukuthi bazilungiselele nakakhulu kwizifo eziyimpathamhlaba.
Hausa: Hakazalika, suna son taimakawa mutane su kasance cikin shiri don annobar.
Northern Sotho: Go swana le ka tsea ye, ba nyaka go thuša batho gore ba itokišetše mauba le go feta.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ሰዎች ለወረርሽኞች በበለጠ ሁኔታ ዝግጁ እንዲሆኑ መርዳት ይፈልጋሉ፡፡

Source: The authors of this study were from Tunisia, Australia, Brazil, Polan, Spain, America, Jordan, India, and Germany.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’okunoonyereza kuno baali bava mu ggwanga lya Tunisia, Australia, Brazil, Poland, Spain, Amerika, Jordan, Buyindi ne Bugirimaani.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé ìwádìí yìí wá láti Tunisia, Australia, Poland, Spain, America, Jordan, India àti Germany.
Zulu: Ababhali balolu cwaningo bebevela e-Tunisia, Australia, Brazil, Polan, Spain, America, Jordan, India, nase- Germany.
Hausa: Mawallafan wannan binciken sun fito ne daga ƙasashen Tunisiya da Australiya da Brazil da Polan da Spain da Amurka da Jordan da Indiya da kuma Jamus.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba dinyakišišo tše ba be ba etšwa Tunisia, Australia, Brazil, Poland, Spain, America, Jordan, India, le Germany.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት አዘጋጆች ከቱኒዚያ፣ ከአውስትራሊያ፣ ከብራዚል፣ከፖላንድ፤ከስፔን፤ከአሜሪካ፣ከጆርዳን ፣ከህንድ እና ከጀርመን ነበሩ፡፡

Source: Many African countries were severely impacted by COVID-19.

Zulu: Amazwe amaningi ase-Afrika athinteke kakhulu nge-COVID-19.
Hausa: Yawancin kasashen Afirka sun kamu da cutar ta COVID-19 sosai.
Northern Sotho: Dinaga tše ntši tša ka Afrika di amilwe gampe kudu ke COVID-19.
Amharic: ብዙ የአፍሪካ ሃገሮች በኮቪድ-19 ክፉኛ ተጎድተዋል፡፡

Source: Because Wikidata is multilingual, it likely helped many Africans access information in languages other than English.
Luganda: Olw’okuba Wikidata erimu ennimi nnyingi, erabika okuba nga yayamba Abafirika bangi okufuna obubaka mu nnimi ezitali Lungereza.
Yoruba: Torí pé ọlọ́pọ̀-èdè ni Wikidata, ó ti lè ran ọ̀pọ̀ ará ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà lọ́wọ́ láti gbà ìròyìn ní àwọn èdè mìíràn yàtọ̀ sí Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi i-Wikidata inezilimi eziningi, cishe isize abantu abaningi base-Afrika ukuthi bathole ulwazi ngezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi.
Hausa: Saboda Wikidata yana da harsuna da yawa, yana iya taimaka wa yawancin ‘yan Afirka samun bayanai a cikin harsuna ban da Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge Wikidata e le ka dipolelo tše ntši, go na le kgonagalo ya gore e ka be e thušitše MaAftika a mantši go fihlelela tshedimošo ka dipolelo tše e sego Seisemane.
Amharic: ዊኪዳታ ባለ ብዙ ቋንቋ ስለሆነ ብዙ አፍሪካውያን ከእንግሊዝኛ ውጪ በሌሎች ቋንቋዎች መረጃን እንዲያገኙ ረድቷቸዋል፡፡
